entities.name: Kree
entities.description: Species that genetically modified humans to create the Inhumans, in war with the Skrulls.

events.summary: The Kree genetically modified humans to spur their evolution and create super soldiers against the Skrulls, creating the Inhumans.
events.quote: They are a species created by the Kree genetically modifying humans

relations.note: The Kree war against the Skrulls.
